settings.title: Holding the steering wheel star (☆) key
settings.description: A short press stays what you pick in the car's own star key menu, which also lists "Battery conditioning: start / stop" and "Battery conditioning: open". Takes effect at the next Apply changes.

options.title: Starts conditioning, or stops it if it's running

settings.title: Notices when conditioning starts, times out or ends
settings.description: After a start, shows the car's own notice when its conditioning indicator comes on, when HMG-API gives up on it, or when the car ends it. The mod's Log (Mods, Manual Preconditioning) records all of it either way.

settings.title: Start again when a route cancels it
settings.description: The car cancels battery conditioning when an Android Auto route starts guiding. When the car ends it within 5 minutes of switching it on (8 on the EV6), with the battery still under the warm limit, the mod starts it once more. Once per press.
